data.body: Gerrit change 2180 patchset 2 pushed. Patchset 1's Verified gate failed on the subprocess-env repr-security meta-test (test_subprocess_env_repr_security.py::test_all_non_fixture_subprocess_environments_use_the_safe_boundary): the new regression test used a raw env={**os.environ, 'GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH': '1'} at test_snapshot_present_sha_no_fetch.py:189, which the boundary audit forbids in tests/. Fixed by routing through the tests/_subprocess_env.subprocess_env() boundary helper (and dropping the now-unused import os). Re-ran the targeted test + the security audit test (24 passed), make lint + make typecheck green. Awaiting re-review (LLM-Review) and Verified on patchset 2.
